title: Transparent character edit and export
purpose: Exercise a reversible pixel edit, local history, effects, export-mode selection, and deterministic transparent PNG downloads in the native motion editor.

steps.title: Open the local studio
steps.expected: The studio loads in a fresh local browser context.

steps.title: Wait for the pixel canvas
steps.expected: The starter character is ready for editing.

steps.title: Add the custom color to the palette
steps.expected: The custom color is selected for painting.

steps.title: Paint the first pixel
steps.expected: The editor records a painted pixel at 1,1.

steps.title: Confirm the edit was recorded
steps.expected: The visible status and activity history report the paint operation.

steps.title: Undo the pixel edit
steps.expected: The canvas returns to its prior state.

steps.title: Confirm undo
steps.expected: The visible status and activity history report the undo.

steps.title: Enable the drift effect
steps.expected: The effect reports an enabled +4 px state.

steps.title: Confirm the drift effect
steps.expected: The inspector exposes the enabled drift amount.

steps.title: Choose sprite-sheet export
steps.expected: The export card changes to Sprite sheet.

steps.title: Capture the edited character
steps.expected: Evidence shows the edited canvas, enabled effect, and sprite-sheet selection.

steps.title: Download the current frame
steps.expected: A non-empty transparent PNG frame is downloaded with the expected name.

steps.title: Download the sprite sheet
steps.expected: A non-empty four-frame PNG sprite sheet is downloaded with the expected name.
